dedupe_keys.name: gbdb carbenmats global buildings database on whole life carbon energy performance and material intensity

description: GBDB CarbEnMats is a seed global buildings database on whole life carbon emissions, energy performance and material intensity, compiled from meta-studies of scientific literature and industry sources with a common data collection template and Python processing, led by Martin Röck with co-authors from Ramboll, Aalborg University, TU Graz, NTNU and others. It covers more than 1,200 building case studies and over 5 million m2 of floor space, with 155 attributes in the core version and over 330 overall (more than 130,000 data points) on context and site, design, LCA method, energy performance, material intensity and greenhouse gas emissions by life cycle stage. The repository holds core and full CSV files, an Excel workbook, attribute and material mapping tables, and notebooks for benchmarking and visualisation. Coverage: buildings worldwide, weighted to studies available in the literature. Access: free on GitHub and Zenodo (pre-release 0.2.0, August 2024; 0.1.0 in 2023, first described in a Research Square preprint). Licence: CC BY 4.0 on Zenodo; the repository's licence file is GPL-3.0. Caveats: a pre-release compilation of heterogeneous studies with many missing attributes, which the authors flag. Simulation uses: embodied and whole life carbon benchmarks and material intensity inputs for stock and LCA models. Related records: the CLF WBLCA Benchmark Study v2 and the YRD and GBA material stocks.
